frontmatter.title: Basic CLI: Package Management - A Comprehensive Guide
frontmatter.subheading: Mastering CLI-Based Package Management Across Different Systems
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to manage packages efficiently using CLI tools like `apt`, `dpkg`, `yum`, `snap`, `gem`, `pip`, and `git`. This guide covers installation, removal, updates, and best practices for package management on various Linux distributions and programming environments.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
